systems.owner: Direction générale de l'état civil, Ministère de l'Intérieur, with UNICEF support
systems.tiers: civil-status computerisation deployed in 103 communes nationally as of 7 May 2025, 40 more being integrated; WURI aims to computerise 87 more communes by end 2025; records digitised in four pilot communes

note: The 7 May 2025 review workshop reports the civil-status solution INCI deployed in 103 communes, with no total of communes given; it states computerisation of a service, not a connection at the commune offices, so no fact is taken.
